name: FlyLong hands its balance-setting admin role to any empty caller
summary: FlyLong (FLG) is an obfuscated token whose tradingTake(account, amount) overwrites any balance, gated only by exemptTeam[msg.sender]; the public tokenMarketing(account) sets exemptTeam[account] for any account holding under 100,000 wei of BNB, once, with no check on the caller. The attacker's helper flash-swapped 99.99% of the FlyLong/WBNB pair's WBNB and in pancakeCall called tokenMarketing(itself) and tradingTake(pair, 100,000 times the pair's FLG balance), so the pair's K check passed with nothing repaid and 1.726 WBNB left the pair.
notes: Reset: deployment, which also created the pair; the deployer's later tokenShould() only cleared the displayed owner. tokenMarketing works once (it sets tokenSwap), and the anchor's call was its first, so no earlier caller held the role; exemptTeam was otherwise only the deployer's, whose own uses are privileged. campaign.mjs finds no other exercise through 90 days after, and the anchor left the pair 0.00017 WBNB.

The token is a scam template (an owner-settable isAuto check can block sells), and the drained WBNB was the liquidity of its deployer 0x09dd0143, which held all but 1,000 wei of the LP supply; the attacker 0xd4e11065 sent its proceeds to Tornado Cash and has no other visible link to it. Loss is the pair's WBNB outflow.
